hints.title: Hamiltonian Grid Path Search
hints.text: The problem asks for paths that start at 1, end at 2, and visit every empty square (0) exactly once.

hints.title: Empty Cell Target Counting
hints.text: Count all non-obstacle cells (empty cells plus start). A valid path reaching 2 must have exactly decremented the remaining cell count to 0.

hints.title: Backtracking Grid Traversal
hints.text: Find start coordinate and total walkable squares. Use recursive search: mark current cell as obstacle (-1), explore 4 neighbors. When landing on 2, return 1 if remaining walkable squares equals 0, else 0. Restore cell after recursive calls.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simple DP fails because paths can move in all four directions and must remember exact visited sets.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since grid size R * C <= 20, exhaustive backtracking explores only valid self-avoiding paths within tight runtime limits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should count non-obstacle cells beforehand and verify that all cells were visited when reaching cell 2.
complexity.notes: In-place cell modification (setting grid[r][c] = -1) eliminates auxiliary visited matrices.
